assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of syncope
The patient presents with transient neurological deficits
The neurological deficits are suggestive of transient cerebral ischemic attacks
The mobile cardiac telemetry is ordered to evaluate for underlying arrhythmias
The mobile cardiac telemetry is ordered to evaluate for hemodynamic instability
The arrhythmias or hemodynamic instability may be contributing to the syncopal events
The arrhythmias or hemodynamic instability may be contributing to cerebral hypoperfusion
The clinical indication supports the medical necessity of CPT 93229
The claim was denied based on Reason Code CO-197
